scope: Only supplied F0/F1 fixed training-side inputs. No original-dev labels, new inference, fit, threshold search, candidate changes or official-B changes.

normalization.document_patient: str(pmc_id), str(patient_id); validate supplied patient membership per actual input; deduplicate identical tuples.
normalization.entity_typed_raw: identifier == '-1' produces ('text', original text), preserving type/value even None. Otherwise split only full syntactically valid HP:ddddddd compound identifiers into atomic HPO. Malformed/mixed identifiers are separate reported exceptions, never silently made HPO.
normalization.entity_typed_canonical: Map atomic HPO through frozen official2026 alt map; retain text separately; no ancestor expansion or text normalization. Record nonbranch/obsolete/unknown exceptions rather than silently changing denominator.
normalization.old_prompt_type: Resolve code_map value against exact old entity association_keys mapping. Raw HPO and raw '-1' text stay distinct; a value that collides across both types is reported ambiguous, not guessed from regex alone.
normalization.public_prompt: Only current valid canonical HPO code_map values; compare with frozen union.new-concepts, and full public2 canonical minus typed canonical oldpool. No second threshold on hybrid row score.
normalization.v2_vs_canonical: Public v2 associations splits only full valid HPO compounds and does NOT canonicalize alt IDs. Posthoc canonical coverage must be labeled diagnostic and not substituted into score/FN denominator without a separate literal view.

spaces_before_any_gold.T: (doc, canonical HPO) from CURRENT fixed LGB selected entities, ignoring its copied association field. Text concepts reported separately.
spaces_before_any_gold.O: (doc, kind, value) from old candidate entities after typed normalization; this is not old model positive relationships.
spaces_before_any_gold.L_old: Actual (doc, patient, typed raw concept) from each old prompt code_map value crossed with that same prompt patient_ids; then diagnostic canonical HPO projection.
spaces_before_any_gold.L_pub: Actual (doc, patient, canonical HPO) from frozen public-new prompt code_map crossed with that prompt patient_ids.
spaces_before_any_gold.L: L_old union L_pub; legal prompt opportunity, not positive outputs or recovered answers.
spaces_before_any_gold.M: T concepts for which no canonical document-HPO in L exists. Also report any patient-specific missing combinations if prompt patient coverage differs.
checks: L_old document typed concepts versus O exact before and after canonicalization; raw-to-canonical collisions explicit.
L_pub document concepts versus frozen union.new-concepts and native public2 canonical minus O.
All selected Task1 entity exact keys occur in its frozen input pool; retain source flags from exact key.
Public spaces include native dictionary/abbreviation canonical rows regardless of hybrid score <=.95.

source_attribution_before_gold.level: For M use document-canonical HPO membership across COMPLETE three native canonical caches; additionally OR source flags across actually selected mention exact keys. Keep the two levels separately.
primary_disjoint_order: public2_present_but_not_prompted: member of complete PubMed/Bioformer canonical doc-HPO but absent L; indicates mapping/difference/prompt-contract discrepancy requiring diagnosis, not assumed threshold loss.
BioBERT_only_native: absent complete public2 canonical doc-HPO and present BioBERT canonical doc-HPO.
nonpublic_or_other: absent all three complete public canonical doc-HPO; subdivide selected original source flags base/Sap/CRF and missing/ambiguous provenance.
orthogonal_observations: Any selected exact mention carries biobert/public/bioformer present, neural, dictionary or abbreviation flags.
At doc-HPO/source level: max observed native hybrid score, any score>.95, all scores<=.95; missing is unknown, never score0.
At mention-key level: BioBERT-present does not imply BioBERT-only at document level.
The <=.95 observation is not causal attribution: existing F0/F1 canonical-to-prompt source has no second score filter.

later_gold_linked_FN_definition_not_exec.required_unresolved_input: Root must freeze CURRENT complete relation prediction for F0 and F1. Do not use Task1 lightgbm.nested association or old positive outputs as legal space.
later_gold_linked_FN_definition_not_exec.literal_view: Compute atomic linked-HPO G_literal and P_literal using unchanged publicv2 compound splitting; FNs=G_literal-P_literal. Keep non-HPO/text outside linked subset with explicit counts. Label this a subset diagnostic, not new v2 evaluation.
later_gold_linked_FN_definition_not_exec.canonical_view: Separately canonicalize valid atomic HPO with official alt map; report collapse/unknown/nonbranch changes and canonical FN count. Do not call it official raw-v2 FN.
later_gold_linked_FN_definition_not_exec.opportunity: Intersect fixed M×supplied patients and each pre-frozen source category with linked FN; report document-HPO and patient-HPO counts/fractions. This is oracle input supply opportunity, not expected TP recovery or score gain.
later_gold_linked_FN_definition_not_exec.freeze_order: Freeze all spaces, categories, source refs and proposed aggregation before reading F0/F1 gold. No per-gold candidate selection, prompt extension, model rerun or threshold sweep.
later_gold_linked_FN_definition_not_exec.output: Aggregate counts by fold/category; full keys remain outside Git if owner later authorizes them. No patient text/gold payload in repository notes.
